IS_count.counting_unit: one matched CDS annotation row, irrespective of the number of matched families

AMRFinderPlus.ARG_class_count: number of unique non-missing Class strings among retained records

MOB_typer.has_oriT: orit_type(s) is non-missing, non-empty and not '-'
MOB_typer.has_relaxase: relaxase_type(s) is non-missing, non-empty and not '-'
MOB_typer.has_MPF: mpf_type is non-missing, non-empty and not '-'

sequence_features.plasmid_length: number of sequence characters after FASTA whitespace removal
sequence_features.kmer: forward strand, overlapping windows, no circular wrap, no reverse-complement pooling; a window is valid only when every base is A/C/G/T; frequency denominator is the number of valid windows

CDS_features.coding_density: union length of 0-based half-open CDS location parts / plasmid length, rounded to four decimals
CDS_features.compound_locations: each joined/circular location part is added to the interval union; the bounding span is never used

CONJScan.feature: maximum sys_wholeness after dropping duplicate sys_id values; zero only when the run completed and no system was detected
